links.outcome: Causal effect of AI ploidy score on implantation failure in development and external cohorts
links.effect: ATE -0.131 (95% CI -0.196, -0.066) in development cohort and -0.157 (95% CI -0.254, -0.054) in external cohort; association held externally.
links.quote: Propensity score matching established a robust association between FEMI-Ploidy and implantation failure showing an average treatment effect (ATE) of -0.131 (95% CI [-0.196, -0.066]) in the development cohort and -0.157 (95% CI [-0.254, -0.054]) in the external cohort.

links.outcome: Comparative efficacy of FEMI high-risk score versus other scoring mechanisms on implantation treatment effect
links.effect: High-risk FEMI score carried significantly stronger ITE penalty on implantation than other scoring mechanisms (p < 0.0001), persisting after adjusting for maternal age.
links.quote: Comparative efficacy using S-Learner models demonstrated that a high-risk FEMI score carried a significantly stronger individual treatment effect (ITE) penalty on implantation compared to other scoring mechanisms (p < 0.0001).

unlisted_practices: Target trial emulation with propensity score matching and S-Learner models to approximate causal effects before prospective RCTs

screen.reason: Evaluates a foundational AI model (FEMI) for embryo assessment using a target trial emulation methodology on retrospective multi-center cohorts.
